page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Configured on the x86_64 architecture, it provides 12 physical cores and 24 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. System memory totals 93.0 GB, delivering approximately 3.88 GB per core alongside 33 MB of L3 cache. Dedicated acceleration is provided by a single bundled NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance has no local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Performance testing indicates a clear division between CPU and GPU performance profiles. Single-core CPU benchmarks fall into the lower tiers, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0 and low single-threaded gzip compression performance. Multi-core operations show moderate capacity, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 7397.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 18301.8. In contrast, the NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers high efficiency in artificial intelligence workloads, achieving top-tier LLM prompt processing speeds of 1130.26 tokens per second for a 7B model.

From an engineering perspective, this instance profile offers targeted cost efficiency for workloads that require modest CPU host capabilities paired with GPU acceleration. The combination of 24 vCPUs, 93.0 GB RAM, and a 16 GB T4 GPU makes it well suited for small-to-medium model inference, computer vision pipelines, and GPU-accelerated batch jobs. However, applications requiring high single-threaded CPU speed or fast local scratch disks will face performance trade-offs.
